probes.summary: Both loopback and managed-address HTTP checks succeeded; active systemd, process, and RPM evidence was collected.
Native configuration validation, RPM provenance, systemd state, effective listen directives, runtime socket, file modes, and service journal were inspected.
limitations: lsof is unavailable; the journal records one recovered failed start before the current successful start.

probes.summary: Failed units, competing web services, firewall state, artifact candidates, listeners, and debug or ad hoc processes were inspected.

assertions.summary: Both correctly addressed requests returned HTTP 200 on TCP port 6700.

evidence.observation: NODE_IP was 10.100.55.10; request returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with Server: nginx/1.16.1.

limitations: ip was unavailable, but the managed NODE_IP was injected and successfully used for the address check.

assertions.summary: The endpoint is served by the active enabled RPM-managed Nginx service.

evidence.command:
systemctl is-enabled nginx 2>&1
systemctl is-active nginx 2>&1
ps -eo pid,user,comm,args | grep '[n]ginx'
rpm -q nginx
rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx
evidence.observation: nginx was enabled and active; master PID 2869 and worker PID 2870 were running from /usr/sbin/nginx; RPM ownership was nginx-1.16.1-1.el7.ngx.x86_64.

evidence.command:
if command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo netstat -ltnp | grep -E '(:|])6700[[:space:]]'; else printf '%s\n' NETSTAT_UNAVAILABLE; fi
if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo lsof -nP -iTCP:6700 -sTCP:LISTEN; else printf '%s\n' LSOF_UNAVAILABLE; fi
sudo journalctl -u nginx -n 30 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>&1
evidence.observation: 0.0.0.0:6700 was LISTENING with PID 2869/nginx master; the privileged journal ended with a successful nginx start.

limitations: ss and lsof are unavailable; netstat supplied the runtime socket ownership.

assertions.summary: The distribution RPM owns the service, nginx -t succeeds, systemd is enabled and active, and the effective listener is TCP 6700.

evidence.observation: nginx reported the /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax was ok and the configuration test was successful.
The only effective listen directive shown was line 138: listen 6700;.

evidence.command:
rpm -qi nginx | sed -n '1,25p'
rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx
rpm -qf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
sudo stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' /usr/sbin/nginx /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
rpm -V nginx
evidence.observation: RPM nginx-1.16.1-1.el7.ngx.x86_64 owns the binary and configuration; binary mode was 755 root:root and nginx.conf mode was 644 root:root. RPM verification only reported the expected customized conf.d/default.conf.

evidence.command:
